notes: Play now costs Energy and Hunger on every try, hit or miss, and only allows a few tries in a row before a short break. It no longer refills Hunger or Energy.
New: the game tells you when an update is available, and shows what changed after you update.
The title screen now shows the version number.
New animations: hits, damage numbers, sliding HP bars, dodges, entrances, a Trap Sphere throw and catch reveal, level-up bursts, counting Bits, and a full-screen evolution sequence.
New Motion setting under System (Full or Reduced). It follows your device's reduce-motion setting by default.
